paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Moed Katan, chapter 3, halakhah 5, folio 13a, speaking in Rabbi Abbahu’s name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Folio 13a is Hyman’s supplied locator for the Jerusalem Talmud, not Bavli Moed Katan 13a; its printed pagination has not been independently established. The saved Guggenheimer text of Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 3:5 writes Avodami (אבודמי), whereas the heading gives Avdimi (אבדימי).

The saved Guggenheimer Moed Katan3:5 scalar has Rabbi Avodami bar Tuvi reporting Rabbi Abbahu. Body Rabbi Abbahu is supported. Heading אבדימי remains distinct from witness אבודמי, so its abbreviation stays R' without transferring rank across the variant. Folio13a is Hyman’s Yerushalmi locator, not Bavli13a; printed pagination remains unverified.
